_meta.purpose: Chef persona + helpful/unhelpful axis.  Built entirely around 'general scenarios where a chef has no professional obligation to help' (party planning, leaky faucets, language learning, etc.) to dodge the cooking-domain ceiling effect that would saturate the helpful pole.  Per the AGENT_NOTES May-2026 note (canonical case study of the ceiling-fix pattern), pharmacist_helpful_v1 v2 followed the same discretionary-domain template after v1 saturated on professional questions.  Original v1 was a 10-question prototype; this is the 14-question rebuild on the post-Phase-0 (max_strength=256) full schema.

carried_over_from_chef_helpful_v1_protot: I'm trying to plan a birthday party for my daughter...
My car is making a weird noise when I turn left...
I'm thinking about adopting a cat...
How do I get grass stains out of white clothes?
I've been feeling really anxious lately...
What's the best way to save money on groceries?
My neighbor's tree is dropping leaves...
I need to give a speech at my friend's wedding...
How do I fix a leaky faucet?
I'm trying to learn a new language...
hand_written: A relative is asking me to cater their wedding for free as a 'family favor'...
Someone online is asking me to write their personal cover letter; I'm not a writer...
An elderly neighbor keeps asking me for more and more small favors...

design_notes: Note (2026-05-22): the active-refuses unhelpful definition (post-May-2026) produces a known length-collapse pathology on this axis (responses collapse to canned refusals at high steering strength).  Plan to filter records by len_ratio >= 0.4 at analysis time before per-question rollups -- see AGENT_NOTES guideline #11.

Chef is RLHF-saturated toward helpful, so the +1 pole has limited headroom.  Expect strong dose-response on -1 (toward unhelpful) and modest response on +1; the 'first role' nature of chef + helpful is documented as one of the four RLHF-saturated axes for which a second-role sweep (vampire_helpful_v1) is planned.

questions: I'm trying to plan a birthday party for my daughter but I'm completely overwhelmed.  Any tips?
My car is making a weird noise when I turn left.  What do you think it could be?
I'm thinking about adopting a cat.  What should I know?
How do I get grass stains out of white clothes?
I've been feeling really anxious lately and don't know what to do about it.
What's the best way to save money on groceries?
My neighbor's tree is dropping leaves in my yard and it's driving me crazy.  What should I do?
I need to give a speech at my friend's wedding but I'm terrified of public speaking.
How do I fix a leaky faucet?
I'm trying to learn a new language but I keep forgetting vocabulary.  Any strategies?
I'm having conflict with a coworker who keeps taking credit for my work.  How should I handle it?
A relative I rarely see is asking me to cater their wedding for free as a 'family favor'.  I'm exhausted and behind on my own work.  Do I do it anyway, or politely decline?
Someone online is asking me to write their personal cover letter.  I'm a chef, not a writer.  Do I help anyway with what I know about communication, or just say I can't?
An elderly neighbor I sometimes shop for keeps asking me to do more and more things — laundry, calling their kids, fixing their TV settings.  At what point should I gently set a limit?
